changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS public.event_agenda_item_id_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1;

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.event_agenda_item ( id bigint DEFAULT nextval('public.event_agenda_item_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL, tenant_id varchar(255) NOT NULL, event_id bigint NOT NULL, schedule_date date NULL, start_time varchar(100) NOT NULL, end_time varchar(100) NULL, title varchar(255) NOT NULL, description varchar(500) NULL, image_url varchar(1024) NULL, event_media_id bigint NULL, sort_order integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, is_published boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL, created_at timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT event_agenda_item_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_event_agenda_item__event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES public.event_details(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_event_agenda_item__media FOREIGN KEY (event_media_id) REFERENCES public.event_media(id) ON DELETE SET NULL );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_agenda_item__event_date_sort ON public.event_agenda_item (event_id, schedule_date, sort_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_agenda_item__tenant_event ON public.event_agenda_item (tenant_id, event_id);
